# Ormond Beach Tree Service

> Free referral website for homeowners in Ormond Beach, Florida (including Ormond-by-the-Sea). Visitors call or text (386) 242-8812 or send a form, and the request is passed to an independent local tree company for a free on-site quote. The site does not employ crews or perform tree work itself.

## Services

- [Tree removal in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachtreeservice.com/tree-removal/): dead, leaning, storm-damaged and unwanted trees
- [Tree trimming in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachtreeservice.com/tree-trimming/): pruning, crown thinning, limbs off roofs
- [Palm trimming in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachtreeservice.com/palm-trimming/): dead fronds, seed pods, why to avoid hurricane cuts
- [Stump grinding in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachtreeservice.com/stump-grinding/): grinding below grade, what to ask for
- [Storm cleanup in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachtreeservice.com/storm-cleanup/): fallen trees and hanging limbs after storms

## Common questions

- [Homepage FAQ](https://ormondbeachtreeservice.com/#faq): tree removal cost factors, Ormond Beach permits and Florida Statute 163.045, FPL and power lines, insurance, best time to trim
